program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((control (cell-at g 0 0)))
    (foldl
      (lambda (obj acc)
        (if (= (obj-color obj) 7)
            (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                   (r0 (first bb))
                   (c0 (second bb))
                   (r1 (third bb))
                   (c1 (fourth bb))
                   (cells (obj-cells obj))
                   (interior (if (and (< (+ r0 1) r1) (< (+ c0 1) c1))
                                 (positions-in-rect (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1) (- r1 1) (- c1 1))
                                 (list)))
                   (hollow
                     (any?
                       (lambda (p)
                         (and (= (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)
                              (not (member p cells))))
                       interior)))
              (if (or (and (= control 1) hollow)
                      (and (= control 2) (not hollow)))
                  (paint-cells acc cells 8)
                  acc))
            acc))
      (set-cell g 0 0 0)
      (objects g 0))))
